justification: User-facing flood page copy and the paid-PDF route. Not Critical: no rule or data change; the route change only refuses. Not Minor: changes what every flood result says and removes liability copy.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if lender/valuer/underwriter copy, the 'In paid report' box, the word 'safe', or a bare dash returns, or if the none verdict loses its limits sentence.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: property_reports: 0 of 368 flood rows store flood_signal (live query 2026-10-28), so the PDF route had no level to print.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The previous assertions (multiple independent flood sources, 0 events since 2000) failed against the new copy and were replaced.

pre_impl.existing_data: FloodTool renders FLOOD_SIGNAL_META per flood_signal; PDF path A reads property_reports.outputs.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 'Historical inundation events since 2000' row counted the three 2022 extent maps, not events since 2000.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component; copy edited in place and FreePaidComparison removed.
pre_impl.external_source_error: PDF route returns 409 when the stored row has no level; a missing level never prints as none.
